_readme: The coach's research library. Each entry is a PMC article fetched from Europe PMC by scripts/coach/build-kb.ts, which refuses any article whose licence is not CC BY or CC0 — checked twice, in the article's own XML and in Europe PMC's metadata. To add a paper: append its PMCID here and run `npm run coach:kb`. Candidates were found by searching Europe PMC for position stands, consensus statements and meta-analyses; several strong papers (ISSN ketogenic diets, ISSN female athlete, the BJSM protein meta-analysis) are CC BY-NC and are deliberately absent.
